title: Fan-out from one topic to two queues
claim: An SNS topic sends a copy of each message to every subscribed queue, and each queue keeps its copy for its own consumer.
alt: A publisher on the left sends to one SNS topic. Arrows go from the topic to two SQS queues; the arrow to the second queue carries a filter policy label. Each queue has its own consumer on the right, and a dead-letter queue sits under each queue.

edges.label: publish
edges.say: The publisher sends one message to the topic.

edges.label: copy
edges.say: SNS sends the message to each subscribed queue.

edges.label: filter policy
edges.say: A subscription with a filter policy gets a message only when the message attributes or the message body satisfy the conditions specified in the filter policy.

edges.label: polls
edges.say: Each consumer polls its own queue, where the messages persist in an Amazon SQS queue until it reads them.
